rows.grounds: compound śakti-dhvaja-upariṣṭāt with enclitic tu; fused form kept as one token
vā combined with atha introducing an alternative

items.question: What element may be placed above the spear-banner in this prescribed form?
premises: The location specified is above the spear-banner.
One permitted element is a leaf.
An alternative permitted element is one furnished with a spear.
items.inference: The form above the spear-banner admits either a leaf or a spear-bearing element as valid alternatives.
uncertainties: The exact referent of patraṃ (leaf, blade, or petal-like ornament) is context-dependent.
The precise object described by saśūlakam is not fully specified in this verse alone.
items.plain_english: Above the spear-banner there may be a leaf, or alternatively an element furnished with a spear.
